original: WPRPLACE is a national park on the North West Coast of Tasmania, Australia. It is located at a geographical headland and surrounds the town of Sisters Beach. It is located approximately 365 km by car northwest of State Capital Hobart. In [dated source], the official name of the cape was changed to pinmatik / Rocky Cape.

Es liegt etwa 365 km mit dem Auto nordwestlich von State Capital Hobart. In [datiert Quelle] wurde der offizielle Name des Umhangs in pinmatik / Rocky Cape geändert.
